D_N^4<=B N log(N+1) implies both existing model conditions; any fixed polylogarithmic faithful dimension satisfies this after increasing B.
The original-boundary application uses only the already established actual GL count via diag(A,1); all geometric conclusions retain their prior hypotheses.
